results.title: Transparency in Coverage - Federal Register
results.content: These proposed rules, if finalized, would add a definition of the term health insurance market for purposes of amendments to [26 CFR 54.9815-2715](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-26/section-54.9815-2715)A3(b)(1)(ii), 29 CFR 2590.715-2715A3(b)(1)(ii), and [45 CFR 147.212(b)(1)(ii)](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/section-147.212#p-147.212(b)(1)(ii)) that would require group health plans and health insurance issuers offering group or individual health insurance coverage to make an out-of-network allowed amount machine-readable file available for each health insurance market in which the plan or issuer offers a plan or coverage. The Transparency in Coverage final rules at [26 CFR 54.9815-2715](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-26/section-54.9815-2715)A3; 29 CFR 2590.715-2715A3; and [45 CFR 147.212](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/section-147.212) require non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers offering non-grandfathered group and individual health insurance coverage to disclose on a public website, in the format of machine-readable files, information regarding in-network provider rates for covered items and services, out-of-network allowed amounts and billed charges for covered items and services, and negotiated rates and historical net prices for covered prescription drugs.
